description: Redacted structural fixture derived from seven Agent Host provider-input snapshots for one hello chat.

redaction.systemPrompt: Original system and reminder text replaced with fixed safe text; the Agent Host identity prefix and session_context path shape are preserved.
redaction.humanPrompt: The original human text and reminder content are replaced with the safe prompt hello and fixed reminder text.
redaction.tools: All tool names, inputs, and results are replaced with fixture_tool, empty objects, and fixed safe text.
redaction.identifiers: Raw session UUID and tool-call IDs are replaced consistently. cN/rN preserve each tool-call/result relationship.
redaction.paths: The username is replaced with REDACTED and the session UUID with a fixture UUID.

shapeEncoding: Each snapshot shape is a semicolon-separated message list. s/a/u mean system/assistant/user; t is a redacted text part; cN is a tool call; rN is its matching result. Synthetic IDs retain the observed call/result relationships.
